in_sanskrit.name: आव्यंश
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Belonging to Avyayanga (Avyayan), the imperishable one, the everlasting one, or the one who never diminishes. It is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Avyay' and 'Ang' meaning imperishable and body, respectively.

in_tamil.name: அவ்யாங்ஷ
in_tamil.long_meaning: Belonging to Avyayam (Avyayan), the imperishable one, the everlasting one, or the one who never diminishes. It is a compound name derived from the Tamil words 'Avvayam' and 'Avvangal' meaning imperishable and body, respectively.

in_telugu.name: అవ్యంశ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Belonging to Avyayanga (Avyayan), the imperishable one, the everlasting one, or the one who never diminishes. It is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words 'Avyay' and 'Ang' meaning imperishable and body, respectively. In Telugu, the word 'Ang' is translated as 'Yojanam', meaning body or region.

in_marathi.name: Avyansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Intelligent, wise, beautiful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avyansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avyansh means one who is intelligent, wise, beautiful, and strong. Avyansh is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit word 'avya' meaning intelligent and 'ansh' meaning end or limit. It is a name that signifies one who is intelligent beyond measure and has the power to overcome any obstacle.
